acceptance: Each item has a test proven red without its fix
The host integration tests of gaterun pass at shadow and enforce
One symlink-resolving helper serves the gate profile and the bridge read isolation
G2 page: the FloorEntryRun example call at line 427 passes (ctx, in, ports), and the Risks bullet "A missed reach" says the sandbox of 7.16 denies the exec or .git read
fix: Split darwin into darwinShadow and darwinEnforce; give NO_EVIDENCE its own kind and the origin gaterun.Finish; delete the nil guards and their test; treat ldd output not a dynamic executable as no libraries; emit NO_EVIDENCE with cause truncated when a rule hits the cap; scope file-read-metadata to the grants and their parents if the host run allows it. Make bridge use sandbox.canonical (or move one helper to a shared package) and delete canonicalOrSelf.
summary: Round 2 of the G2 part (b) review left non-blocking items: darwinStrategy forks on a report bool where Linux has one type per mode; NO_EVIDENCE uses KindIsolationViolation and the origin gaterun.Run is emitted from Finish; the nil-emitter guards in signals.go contradict the NewStrategy refusal; glibc ldd exits 1 on a static binary, so Linux enforce refuses a CGO-off evolve; ParseReports drops reports past the per-rule cap with no signal; the canaries do not detect a loss in the middle of a run; file-read-metadata is allowed everywhere. The final review (agent-architecture-reviewer-20261111T100434Z-767e, MEDIUM) found sandbox.canonical and bridge.canonicalOrSelf resolve symlinks twice in two packages.
title: Close the round-2 MEDIUM and LOW items of the hermetic gate (G2 part b)
